name: The Off Beat Parade
description:
Your path is suddenly blocked by a strange parade.
A group of Off Beat Hoppits are dancing in completely wrong rhythm
They shout JOIN US JOIN US DANCING WRONG IS FUN
It is chaotic and painful yet strangely cheerful
desc0: You try to mimic their chaotic rhythm and fail badly but the Hoppits adore your enthusiasm
desc1: You spend some time to sync their rhythm

name: The Giraffe’s Infinite Note
description: Ahead of you, a Long-Note Giraffe is holding a very, very, VERY long note - so long it has wrapped around the mountains twice.\nHe looks light-headed but cannot stop.
desc0: You send out a precise pitch-cut.The note snaps instantly.\nThe giraffe collapses, gasping:“Thank you… I haven’t breathed in three days…”
desc1: You join his long note. Your pitch stabilizes his vibration,forming a soothing harmonic drone.\nHe bows gratefully and leaves.

name: Cloud Chorus Auditions
description: A group of Noise Puffs are auditioning for the Royal Cloud Chorus but can only produce static hisses and pops\nThe judges are arguing about which noise texture is better and you are dragged in as a guest judge
desc0: The chosen puff vibrates happily and gives you a fluffy little gift
desc1: You try hard to teach them real notes They fail completely but create a lovely accidental harmony\nFor the next 2 battles all enemies deal 15 percent less damage

name: Jump Beat Bridge
description: You reach a bridge that vibrates in rhythmic pulses stepping off beat launches you upward\nA sign beside it reads Be careful no compensation for missed beats
desc0: You cross gracefully by stepping in perfect rhythm
desc1: You are bounced violently but you make it across. You tumble to the other side of the bridge and spot something shiny in the grass.

name: The Harmonic Cave Collapse
description: A cave entrance shines with golden glimmers hinting at rich gold deposits inside\nBut the ceiling makes subtle clicking noises as if it could collapse any moment

name: The Percussion Forest
description: You enter a forest where trees produce drum sounds when hit\nOne tree asks politely for you to hit it assures you it does not hurt
desc0: The tree produces a crisp drum hit and is pleased
desc1: The tree spins and scolds you

name: Earplug Merchant
description: A merchant sells giant earplugs labeled Princess Song Defense\nHe insists you need them
